title: File:Bishopsgate Bomb April 1993 - London IRA bomb 03.jpg
desc:
The IRA Bishopsgate bomb in London on April 24th 1993.
These photos were taken a few days after the bomb. I personally went into the site to retrieve a computer server - I got it, even under all that mess!
